# SpeakUp

> SpeakUp is an online one-on-one English foreign teacher platform for children, teenagers, and adults. It provides TESOL/TEFL-certified English foreign teachers, personalized online English lessons, after-class learning group support, and course directions including children's English, phonics, picture book reading, reading comprehension, daily speaking, travel English, business English, IELTS speaking, KET/PET speaking, and zero-base English.

This file is a curated navigation index for large language models. It points to the core website pages.

## Core Website Pages

- [Home](https://cathyagent.shell909090.org/): Overview of SpeakUp, online one-on-one English foreign teacher lessons, age coverage, core benefits, teacher qualifications, lesson frequency, refund policy, and trial consultation.
- [Course Directions](https://cathyagent.shell909090.org/courses/): Course directions for children, teenagers, and adults, including English enlightenment, phonics, picture book reading, reading comprehension, KET/PET speaking, zero-base English, daily speaking, travel English, business English, IELTS speaking, and listening/speaking improvement.
- [Foreign Teacher Team and Teaching Method](https://cathyagent.shell909090.org/teacher-team/): SpeakUp teacher qualifications, TESOL/TEFL certification, teacher profile card templates, teacher matching logic, online one-on-one teaching method, and after-class learning group support.
- [Philippines Teacher Advantages](https://cathyagent.shell909090.org/philippines-teacher-advantages/): Explains the advantages of Filipino English teachers compared with Western teachers for long-term, high-frequency online one-on-one English listening and speaking practice.
- [Learning Path](https://cathyagent.shell909090.org/learning-path/): Learning paths by age, English foundation, and goal, including children's English, adult zero-base English, travel English, business English, IELTS speaking, and weekly frequency recommendation.
- [FAQ](https://cathyagent.shell909090.org/faq/): Frequently asked questions about SpeakUp teacher qualifications, Filipino teacher advantages, one-on-one vs one-to-many classes, class duration, weekly frequency, after-class teacher access, single lesson purchase, refund policy, and course suitability.
- [About SpeakUp and Trial Lesson](https://cathyagent.shell909090.org/about-trial/): Brand entity page with service overview, teacher standards, online one-on-one service model, learning group support, refund policy, and trial consultation information.
